page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r8a.xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores of an AMD EPYC 9T24 processor running at 2.7 GHz. The instance is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, and it operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark data reveals strong single-core CPU performance, with stress-ng single-core tests placing it in the top 25%. Multi-core CPU performance, PassMark CPU scores, and gzip compression speeds fall within the average range. However, memory bandwidth benchmarks show limitations, with both cached small-block and uncached large-block read-only operations scoring in the bottom 25%. Similarly, database operations, Redis SET operations, and static web serving throughput are positioned in the bottom 25%, indicating potential bottlenecks for I/O-heavy workloads.

The instance offers a qualitative balance of high memory density and dedicated CPU resources, making it suitable for memory-intensive workloads that do not demand extreme memory read bandwidth or local disk storage. Supported CPU instruction sets include AVX-512 and cryptographic acceleration. This configuration is appropriate for caching layers, lightweight in-memory databases, and general-purpose memory-intensive applications that can operate within the 2 Gbps network baseline.
